notes.title: GLOBAL CHALLENGE IS BACK! 25/09/2025
notes.notes: [p]We heard you![/p][p]Global Challenge is back for another round - but this time it is greener..[/p][p]Unite with all online players and work together to dispatch planes when CO2 neutral and fill the global meter.[/p][p]Every flight counts toward unlocking a unique achievement and a speed boost for 24h![/p]
